title: Create a Base Template
description: Design a base template with header, footer, and a content block. Extend it in a home page.
problemStatement:
## Your Mission

Create a base template `base.html` that contains:
- A `<header>` with a site title.
- A `<footer>` with a copyright notice.
- A `<main>` section with a `{% block content %}{% endblock %}`.

Then create a child template `home.html` that extends `base.html` and fills the content block with a welcome message.

Render `home.html` from a view mapped to the root URL.
hints: Place templates in `templates/` folder inside your app, or in a global templates directory.
Use `{% extends "base.html" %}` at the top of `home.html`.
Remember to pass `request` to `render()` in the view.
expectedOutput: When you visit the home page, you see the header, the welcome message, and the footer – all from the base template.
